note: ebfret_session_means are the prior means of ebFRET's saved session for this dataset (simulated-K04-N350-ebfret-session.mat, run to convergence with Precision 1e-5). The signal is ebFRET's (acceptor + eps) / (acceptor + donor + eps) of the raw counts, with the first row of each stacked trace read as its label, which is how tests/test_recovery.py reads it. n_frames counts rows including those label rows.
